The main takeaway from our work is that

ram-pressure stripping can be a significant gas removal mechanism in galaxy groups, especially if the group has a high central gas density and if galaxies are moving through the core of a group with high velocity.
the H I-deficient galaxy in NGC 4065 may have been stripped of its H I gas through a combination of tidal and/or ram-pressure stripping.
